text.title: Roadmap Design Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing tree mapping observable inputs to a rule from `01-core-rules.xml`. MANDATORY for every methodology — even flat ones — per F-066 DoD.

decision-tree.root-question: Do all Applies-If preconditions hold AND no Skip-If disqualifier is true?

branch.question: Has the format been selected from the uncertainty level rather than from audience preference?
Does the roadmap leave the team — is there an external audience?

text.example: All preconditions satisfied, format derived from uncertainty, external view derived and stripped, not-doing list present → conclusion r3-confidence-labels.
